description: This Java class defines a custom JMeter sampler named HonoReceiverSampler, which extends HonoSampler and implements TestBean and ThreadListener. It manages a HonoReceiver instance to perform sampling operations related to Eclipse Hono messaging, including configuration properties such as sender time usage, payload prefetch, and reconnection attempts. The class handles thread lifecycle events to initialize and close the receiver appropriately, and overrides the sample() method to generate test results.

classes.name: HonoReceiverSampler
classes.description: A custom JMeter sampler for Eclipse Hono that manages messaging reception tests, handling receiver configuration and lifecycle.

methods.name: isUseSenderTime
methods.description: Returns whether sender time usage is enabled based on the property.

methods.name: setUseSenderTime
methods.description: Sets whether to use sender time in the sampling configuration.

methods.name: getPrefetch
methods.description: Retrieves the prefetch count as a string.

methods.name: setPrefetch
methods.description: Sets the prefetch count for message retrieval.

methods.name: getSenderTimeVariableName
methods.description: Returns the variable name used for sender time retrieval, defaulting if not set.

methods.name: setSenderTimeVariableName
methods.description: Sets the variable name used for sender time in the payload.

methods.name: isSenderTimeInPayload
methods.description: Determines if the sender time is embedded in the payload.

methods.name: setSenderTimeInPayload
methods.description: Configures whether the sender time is included in the payload.

methods.name: getReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of reconnection attempts as a string.

methods.name: setReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Sets the number of reconnection attempts.

methods.name: sample
